gloss: to postpone; to extend (a deadline or period)

definitions.gloss: to postpone; to put off; to defer
definitions.explanation: To move a scheduled event or deadline to a later time.

definitions.gloss: to extend; to lengthen (a period of time)
definitions.explanation: To make the duration of something — a stay, contract, or deadline — longer than originally planned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{延|の}ばした。
examples.english: I postponed the meeting to next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{延|の}ばすことにした。
examples.english: We decided to put off the departure by one day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{延|の}ばすことになった。
examples.english: Because of the rain, the match was postponed to the next day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧{延|の}ばした。
examples.english: I extended my stay by a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{延|の}ばして⟦もらえません→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you extend the deadline for me?

examples.japanese: {契約期間|けいやくきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧{延|の}ばすこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided to extend the contract period by another six months.

notes:
Kanji variant of ⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧. Use {延|の}ばす for postponing or extending periods of time (deadlines, stays, contracts); use ⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧ for physically stretching things, growing hair, or developing abilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{延|の}ばす: to extend a deadline
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{延|の}ばす: to postpone a meeting
- ⟦{滞在|たいざい}→滞在：03390_taizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{延|の}ばす: to extend one's stay
- ⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{延|の}ばす: to extend one's lifespan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to stretch; to grow — physical extension or developing skills
- ⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧: to postpone — more formal, used for official scheduling changes
